title: Open Truck Contracts per Customer — Bluegate Moving Truck Rental
content:
**Standing rule of the reservations desk for the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental.**

1. A customer may have at most **2** truck rentals open at one time. A truck rental is counted as open while it stands in reserved or picked-up status; the count is taken per customer on the handling date.
2. A customer with a truck rental in returned status, whose final invoice is not yet settled, may not reserve another vehicle until it closes.
3. Each contract covers one vehicle and one renter, who may add authorized drivers at the counter.

The standing of the customer's truck rentals is read from the status of those contracts in the company's records for that customer, not from the customer's description of them.

## Status of an existing contract and its effect on a new reservation

| Status of an existing truck rental of the customer | Counted toward the limit of 2 open rentals | Stands in the way of reserving another vehicle until it closes |
|---|---|---|
| Reserved | Yes | — |
| Picked up | Yes | — |
| Returned (final invoice not yet settled) | — | Yes |
| Closed | No | No |
| Cancelled | No | No |
| No-show | No | No |

## Illustrations (hypothetical customers)

- A customer holds one reserved contract and one picked-up contract: 2 rentals are open, which is the most allowed at one time.
- A customer holds one closed contract and one cancelled reservation: neither is open and neither stands in the way of a new reservation.
- A customer's only other truck rental has been checked in and stands in returned status with its final invoice unsettled: no other vehicle is reserved for that customer until that contract closes.
